name: Frodhes
intro: A Rhodes electric piano computed live from hammer, tine and pickup (no samples), with a reface CP-style effects chain: just play, then turn ALGORITHM for the four piano types.

rows.what: Next / previous page; KNOB 1-4 turn its four cards.
PERFORM page; again: main page (TYPE, DRIVE, REVERB, KEY VEL).
VOICE page: TONE, BARK, BELL, HAMMER.
Octave down (OCT+ up), range ±2.
Piano TYPE from any page (not on SEQUENCER).
F01-F12 factory, U01-U16 yours; loads when you stop.
PERFORM: trem/wah, phaser, chorus, delay amount; up = on.
KEY VEL: your touch; above ~100 the bark comes in.
Sustain pedal; a quick tap latches it, tap again releases.
Chord mode: one key plays a whole chord (OFF to stop).
Arpeggiator on / off; on its page PLAY latches HOLD.
SCALE: OFF / SNAP / DEGREE (white keys walk the scale).
STAGE 77, SUITCASE, EARLY FELT, BELL DYNO.
BARK: the growl of hard notes (KNOB 3 BELL, 4 HAMMER).
DRIVE: amp drive, clean to growl (KNOB 3 REVERB).
DECAY page: DECAY, RELEASE, damper NOISE, TUNE.
ASSIGN: choose what each PERFORM knob plays.
SEQUENCER page: loop recorder, 1-16 bars (KNOB 1).
On SEQUENCER: start / stop the loop (stop = back to bar 1).
On SEQUENCER: recording on / off; playing it overdubs each pass.
On SEQUENCER, 1 second: clear the whole pattern.
On SEQUENCER: left UNDO the last pass, right ERASE mode.
On SEQUENCER: QUANT grid, never changes what you recorded.
All effects off / on (BYP in the header); settings kept.
TREM/WAH on / off; KNOB 1 picks PAN, TREM or WAH.
Phaser on / off.
Delay on / off; KNOB 1 picks DIG or ANA (tape).
One page past PHASER: CHORUS; KNOB 1 switches it on.
One page back: COMPRESSOR; THRESH up from OFF turns it on.
Save to user slot U01-U16 (KNOB 1 picks too).
Leave save mode without saving.
Undo the last preset load: your sound comes back.
Tap tempo (3 taps or more); not on ARPEGGIO / SEQUENCER.
TEMPO: BPM and tremolo / phaser / delay sync.
SETUP: delay tone, preset LEVEL, USB VOL knob / fixed.
MIDI: CHANNEL, TRS IN, CLOCK (INT / AUTO / USB).

tips: The FM-1's keys have no velocity: KEY VEL (main page, KNOB 4) sets how hard they strike; 96-108 is a good start.
Try BELL DYNO for glassy ballads, SUITCASE with TREM/WAH on PAN for the classic stereo vibrato.
Keys play odd notes or keep going? Chord mode (SEQ light), arp HOLD or the sequencer is on.
With chord mode on, SEQ jumps straight to the SEQUENCER page.
Effect depths start at 0; switching one on from its button gives it a useful starting depth.
MASTER is digital: keep it high and turn your speakers down for the least hiss.
Something wrong after an update? Hold OCT- while powering on: USB rescue screen for reinstalling.
checked: v0.9.2 hub mirror, firmware/src/ui.c: PG_ order PERFORM ASSIGN FRODHES VOICE DECAY COMP TREM PHA CHO DELAY TEMPO SCALE CHORD SEQ ARP SETUP MIDI; SELECT clamps, no wrap; PAGE_S / PAGE_LAB card labels.

ui.c ui_input: HOME PERF<->PIANO, EDIT VOICE, ENV ui_fx_button(PG_PHA) / LFO (PG_TREM) / SEL (PG_DELAY): goto, then on the page toggle; FX fx_bypass; SEQ CHORD or SEQ if chord_on, on SEQ press = rec toggle, held 1000 ms = seq_clear; ARP goto then arp_toggle; PLAY: ARP page hold, SEQ page play/stop, else tempo_tap; OCT ±2; ALGORITHM = P_TYPE except on SEQ (cursor).
ui.c PERF_T default TREM/WAH PHASER CHORUS DELAY depths; perf_wake switches the effect on when turned up; fx_wake starting depths; COMP P_CMP_AMT (THRESH) switches it.

presets.c presets_poll: SAVE tap opens save mode, PRESETS or K1 picks U slot, SAVE again stores; HOME or OCT- cancels; SAVE held >= 700 ms (outside save mode) = preset_undo; PRESETS loads 400 ms after last detent, F01-F12 / U01-U16.
frodhes.c sustain_button: REC hold = sustain, tap < 250 ms toggles latch; keys use set.key_vel (default 96, params.c); MIDI channel filter, PC 0-11 / 16-31.
tempo.c tempo_tap: from 3rd tap, 2 s reset; scale_key_note DEGREE: black keys return 255 (silent). seq.c seq_stop resets to bar 1. platform.c line 366: OCT- at power-on -> recovery_main.
unsure: frodhes.c header comment says KEY VEL is on SELECT; the code puts it on the main page KNOB 4 (SELECT turns pages). Sheet follows the code.
Manual says only HOME cancels save mode; presets.c also cancels with OCT-. Not on the sheet.

Sequencer step recording (stopped + REC: ALGORITHM cursor / LENGTH), SWING, PRESETS bar jumps, chord inversion / voicing / strum, arp rate / octaves / gate and the MIDI CC map: verified or documented but left out as too detailed.
No key zones: the 27 keys just play (DEGREE silences the black keys). Not tried on hardware.
